GYNECOLOGICAL SURGERY

Prophylaxis is indicated for abdominal or vaginal hysterectomy with either open

or laparoscopic approach.  Antimicrobials are not indicated after incisions are

closed.

# Preferred prophylaxis

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

# Alternative in patients with beta lactam allergy

[Click here Beta-lactam allergy assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Clindamycin 900mg IV once <AND> Gentamicin 5mg/kg Weight Based once pre-op](orz-set-abx-clindamycin-900mg-gentamicin-5mg-kg-preop)

References:

Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis

in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 vol 70 pages 195-283
